references.text: The same introductory formula where the Lord speaks to Moses, showing God's repeated communication with his servant in the wilderness.
Another occurrence of the common formula 'the Lord spoke to Moses and said', demonstrating the consistent pattern of divine revelation through Moses.
The same Hebrew expression וַיְדַבֵּר יְהוָה אֶל־מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר is used to introduce divine instructions.
Earlier in the same chapter, the same formula is used, showing the continuity of God's instructions regarding the Levites.
Another occurrence in the same chapter where the Lord speaks to Moses about the role of the Levites as a substitute for the firstborn.
